metadata.scope: NSW schools and campuses returned by My School search
metadata.attribution: Source: Australian Curriculum, Assessment and Reporting Authority (ACARA)
metadata.method: 2025 NAPLAN school means standardised within each year level/domain across supplied NSW head schools; weighted domains (reading 30%, numeracy 30%, writing 20%, spelling 10%, grammar 10%), equal weight per expected year level, normal-CDF index 0–100. At least 80% domain weight in EVERY expected NAPLAN year level. Rank within school type; ties share rank. This is an achievement index, not a percentile or overall school-quality rating.
metadata.coverage_note: Expected NAPLAN year levels come from the 2025 school profile year range. Suppressed and missing means stay null. Subcampuses link to their head school and are never independently ranked. Language background and participation do not contribute to the achievement score.
metadata.score_coverage_denominator: NSW head schools in the source directory; campuses are not counted twice
